latents.fact: something thrown in that is now retrievable
latents.item_desc: A {ADJ} object, sitting on the cistern bed. The water has preserved it perfectly.

latents.fact: the reflection is delayed — not by much, but enough to notice
a maintenance hatch set into the wall at the waterline, sealed with a quarter-turn
latents.exit_desc: The hatch yields to a quarter-turn, opening to passages beyond.
